costNote: Delivering the service: payroll and HR operations staff, the PEO's worksite-employee benefit costs, product R&D ($251M) and depreciation ($129M). ADP reports these as 'total costs of revenues'.

opex.note: Sales, account management and corporate overhead.

footerNote: Revenue components: Employer Services $3,685M and PEO Services $1,808M (including $329M of interest earned on funds held for clients), less $3M of reconciling 'other'.

segments.name: Employer Services
segments.note: Payroll and HCM software/services for employers of every size, including $329M of interest earned on client funds awaiting payment. Segment margin 36.5%, up 130bp; US pays per control rose 2%.

segments.name: PEO Services & other
segments.note: The professional employer organization — ADP becomes co-employer for ~771,000 worksite employees. Revenue up 7% (4% excluding zero-margin benefits pass-throughs); segment margin 13.0%. Includes a small negative 'other' reconciling item.

sources.label: ADP Q1 FY2027 earnings release — SEC EDGAR Ex-99.1 (8-K, Oct 28, 2026)

takeaways.text: Interest earned on the $36.9B of client money ADP holds between payday deductions and payouts rose 15% to $329M, as the yield on those balances climbed 30bp to 3.6% — high rates are a real profit engine.
takeaways.title: The float keeps paying

takeaways.text: Adjusted EBIT margin expanded 130bp to 26.8% — ADP beat its own plan on revenue, margin and EPS, and raised full-year guidance for revenue and adjusted EPS growth.
takeaways.title: Margins expanding, guidance raised

takeaways.text: The PEO now pays about 771,000 worksite employees (+2%). Its reported revenue overstates the business — much of the $1.8B is zero-margin benefits money passing through.
takeaways.title: PEO scale keeps growing

verdict: A steady compounder's quarter: 6% growth, margins up 130bp, and the client-money float contributing more as yields rise.
